public_rationale: There is a factual governance component: OpenAI announced Altman's return to its board in March and his membership of a new safety committee in May. But Marcus combines that subject with the expressly subjective phrase 'seeming less and less on the level.' Scoring the whole sentence would require turning an impression into a stronger, measurable accusation that he did not specify. The combined claim should therefore remain unscored.
limitations: This does not reject the separately checkable proposition that Altman's governance role expanded.
The governance announcements do not establish either honesty or dishonesty.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Altman is increasingly consolidating power at OpenAI and appearing less honest.

statement.excerpt: Gary Marcus would prefer not writing about Altman, but Altman is consolidating more and more power and seeming less and less on the level.
statement.document_title: Kara Swisher, Sam Altman, and the OpenAI Board

from_speaker: Altman is consolidating more and more power
seeming less and less on the level
our_interpretation: The statement combines an observable subject—changes in governance authority—with Marcus's expressly qualified impression of Altman's honesty.
The ordinary reading of power consolidation concerns increasing practical influence or formal authority at OpenAI. The sentence supplies no comparison baseline.
I do not replace 'seeming less and less on the level' with a firm claim that a specified dishonest act occurred. That would strengthen Marcus's wording.
The context concerns developments known by May 29, 2024. Later governance changes cannot establish what the ongoing state was when he wrote.
No target period is assigned for outcome scoring because the combined proposition lacks a testable truth condition.
criteria.support_condition: No objective support condition applies to the whole sentence as written. Governance records could support its power component, but cannot establish an unspecified impression of declining honesty.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No objective contradiction condition applies to the whole sentence as written. A governance finding would not falsify Marcus's stated impression.
